name: ripple
blurb: Concentric circles pulse outward from center with staggered timing.
description: Renders expanding circles from a center point with staggered animation delays and fading opacity. CSS-animated loops continuously; positioned absolutely and masks to transparent at bottom.
use_when: A background effect behind a focal point or button to draw attention without blocking interaction.
avoid_when: When you need responsiveness to user input — the ripple loops on its own and cannot pause or reverse.
a11y: Purely decorative; uses pointer-events-none so interactions pass through to elements below. No focus or keyboard handling.
